uuvrSpike.localCopy: artifacts/uuvr/v0.3.1/uuvr-il2cpp-legacy.zip and extracted/analysis copies under artifacts/uuvr/ (all git-ignored)
uuvrSpike.status: FETCHED, NOT INSTALLED. B3 is closed: version, release, byte size, SHA256, SPDX, notice path, plugin id and the patcher's exact write set are recorded here and re-derived every verifier run by tests/uuvr-payload-check.ps1. B4 is half closed: config/uuvr-spike-payload.json freezes UUVR's 36 installed + 23 generated files under 10 narrow owned scopes with one declared stock mutation, and its pre-image in the pinned backup is verified; the transaction engine still has to accept scopes, declared generated files and declared mutations before any install may run.
uuvrSpike.builtAgainst: Uuvr.deps.json: BepInEx.Core/Unity.Common/Unity.IL2CPP 6.0.0-be.692, HarmonyX 2.10.1, Il2CppInterop 1.4.6-ci.426; the patcher csproj references BepInEx.Unity.Mono.Preloader 6.0.0-be.674. This project pins the loader at 6.0.0-be.788, so a loader-line conflict is the expected failure mode.
uuvrSpike.pluginReferencesNote: Read from plugins/Uuvr.dll with the read-only Recon assembly reader (artifacts/uuvr/analysis/plugin-il2cpp/assembly-recon.json, SHA256 D188B8D39A0876D7...). Every referenced name exists in the loader-generated interop set for this build (20261006T145312Z quarantine), so assembly-resolution failure is not the expected failure mode; Unity-generation mismatch (v0.3.1 is built for Unity 2019 or earlier, this target is Unity 2022.3.37f1) and the be.692-vs-be.788 loader line are.
uuvrSpike.pluginMembersNote: Member level re-derived by D-049 with the read-only Recon deps reader (artifacts/uuvr-compat/deps/dependency-recon.json, tests/uuvr-compat-check.ps1). 222 member references: 157 resolve, 1 critical mismatch (Il2CppSystem.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2.get_keys; this interop exposes get_Keys/get__keys, an Il2CppInterop accessor rename between 1.4.6-ci.426 and the pinned be.788), 57 framework System.Runtime-scoped types excluded by rule. Pose/stereo symbols present: InputTracking.GetLocalRotation(XRNode) and GetLocalPosition (UnityEngine.XRModule.dll), XRDevice.DisableAutoXRCameraTracking(Camera,bool) and XRSettings.get_stereoRenderingMode (assembly named UnityEngine.VRModule), Camera stereo members (CoreModule). UnityEngine.XR.CommonUsages is present but empty, so the modern InputDevice feature route is unusable from managed code. Matrix: docs/UUVR-COMPAT.md.
uuvrSpike.patcherWriteSet: Uuvr.Patcher v0.3.1 (read from source): copies its CopyToGame payload into <Game>_Data (StreamingAssets/SteamVR, UnitySubsystems, Plugins/x64) on every launch, deletes five named VR DLLs under _Data/Plugins if present (all five verified absent from this install: D-038 re-checked against the pinned backup), and under LEGACY copies _Data/globalgamemanagers to _Data/globalgamemanagers.bak once and rewrites the original's XR settings with AssetsTools.NET. The patched digest is not predicted; only the pre-image is pinned.
uuvrSpike.licenceNote: Copyleft: reading it and running it as a separate plugin for personal, non-distributed testing creates no distribution obligation; distributing a build that bundles UUVR code makes the combined work GPL-3.0, so the outbound licence choice stays at Stage 10 (D-042). No UUVR source is copied into this repository.
